description: Unsigned trade for a wallet you control: EVM calls (approvals, then the swap) or a base64 Solana transaction. Sign and send them yourself. Solana: 'referral' (a Solana address) receives the referral share of the community fee.

amount.description: Decimal amount: buy = pair currency to spend (e.g. "0.05"), sell = tokens to sell.

game_id.description: TitleID of the game whose token to trade.

referral.description: Solana only: referral address (yours, for example).

wallet.description: Address that will sign and send.

name: build_token_trade
title: Build a token trade
